transcript.text: I need to raise a critical security concern with the current draft. While checking the image-processing deployment manifest for an unrelated access review, I confirmed that customer-uploaded image data must run in exactly the eu-central-1 region and must use the tenant-managed KMS key named tenant_kms. I have not yet opened the security finding, but this needs to be incorporated into the policy before Riley approves it. Specifically, the policy must restrict processing to eu-central-1 only and mandate tenant_kms for all customer image data.
